points.description: States that the alternative to recursion is iteration (using loops, such as for or while loops, to repeat the steps). Equivalent wording, such as 'loops' or 'an iterative approach', earns the mark.

rubric.notes: The model answer is a single idea, so the whole 5 marks sit on one all-or-nothing point. A student earns full marks for naming iteration or an equivalent loop-based approach. A student who names any other technique, or gives no answer, earns no marks.
